incidents.name: DolomiteMarginProtocol callFunction approval drain
incidents.notes: The retired Ethereum DolomiteMarginProtocol exposed callFunction(), which performs an arbitrary external call and is protected only by a noEntry reentrancy modifier that can be bypassed by entering through the unguarded SoloMargin operate path, letting the attacker make the contract transferFrom USDC out of every wallet that still held a stale approval to it.

sources.ref: onchain review: attack tx calls 0x7f49ac8fdb38d24b686130e22579c7efe69b19c0 (verified DolomiteMarginProtocol) with selector 0xd595b2fe from EOA 0x52522d35725836d48e12e64731fa170bcd9423bf; the contract was created 2020-06-11 by Dolomite deployer 0x52256ef863a713ef349ae6e97a7e8f35785145de and has no upgrade events; press reports quoting an address prefix 0xe2466 could not be resolved onchain
